item.title: Isuzu Dominates Philippine Truck Segment With 42.2 Percent Market Share In 2025
item.description: Isuzu Philippines Corporation (IPC) once again affirmed its leadership in the local commercial vehicle industry after retaining its position as the country’s No. 1 truck brand for the 26th consecutive year, highlighting its long-standing commitment to supporting Filipino businesses with durable products, dependable service, and total business solutions.Read More »

item.title: This Solar-Powered Nissan Ariya EV May Not Require Any Recharging At All
item.description: Nissan may have developed a vehicle that may not require any refueling or recharging at all. The solution is ingenious, and at the same time, simple: add solar panels on the Ariya EV.Read More »

item.title: Green GSM Is Now Equipping Its EV Taxis With Tech-Based Secure-To-Safe System
item.description: All-electric taxi company, Green GSM, is leveraging technology to keep its drivers and passengers safe. The company has begun rolling out its Secure-to-Safe (S2S) system which is standard across the entire fleet. And compared to other methods, S2S is designed as a coordinated safety support system that combines technology, procedures, and human response.Read More »

item.title: Jing Atienza Is The New CAMPI President
item.description: The Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc. (CAMPI) enters a new era as Jose Maria “Jing” Atienza officially takes over as President of the automotive industry association. He takes over the reigns from Rommel Gutierrez who steps down after a 14-year stint.Read More »

item.title: Kia Posts Highest Growth Among Mainstream Auto Brands In The Philippines In 2025
item.description: Kia Philippines, a subsidiary of ACMobility, posted 16.7 percent year-on-year growth in 2025, emerging as the fastest-growing mainstream established automotive brand in the country. Retail sales rose from 6,692 units in 2024 to 7,810 units in 2025, reflecting strong consumer confidence in Kia’s vehicles and the brand’s ability to deliver value, innovation, and reliability to Filipino motorists.Read More »
